information_requirement_traceability.description: The system-generated assignment linking a specific order to a designated store partner and a specific time window for preparation and dispatch.

business_requirements.name: Optimized Store Partner Selection
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system must select the optimal store partner for order fulfillment based on a weighted combination of geographic proximity, real-time inventory availability, and authorized service area constraints.
business_requirements.business_objective: To ensure orders are directed to the most efficient physical node capable of meeting the customer's delivery SLA.
business_requirements.business_value: Minimizes total delivery time and maximizes resource utilization by balancing workload across the network.
business_requirements.requirement_basis: The information requirement specifies that tasks must be allocated to the nearest store partner geographically and that routing must optimize for minimizing total delivery time.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: This requirement derives from the functional rule requiring tasks to be allocated to the nearest store and the business purpose of orchestrating work flow to the optimal physical node.

origin.description: The system-generated assignment linking a specific order to a designated store partner and a specific time window for preparation and dispatch.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders allocated to the nearest valid store partner within the service area.
Average reduction in estimated delivery time compared to non-optimized allocation.

policies_and_constraints: Tasks cannot be assigned to stores outside their authorized service area.
Routing must optimize for minimizing total delivery time.
assumptions: Geographic proximity is a primary determinant of delivery efficiency.
Real-time inventory status is accurate at the moment of allocation.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Inventory data latency may lead to allocation to a store that cannot fulfill the order.
Dependency: Accurate delivery zone map and distance metrics are required.

business_requirements.name: SLA-Aligned Time Window Assignment
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system must assign a specific preparation time window to each fulfillment task that aligns with the store's operational hours and the customer's delivery Service Level Agreement (SLA).
business_requirements.business_objective: To ensure orders reach the store staff at the right time to meet delivery commitments without violating store operating constraints.
business_requirements.business_value: Directly impacts customer satisfaction by ensuring orders are prepared and dispatched within the promised timeframe.
business_requirements.requirement_basis: The information requirement mandates that time windows must align with the store's operational hours and that the system must determine the specific time slot for order preparation to meet delivery SLAs.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: This requirement is derived from the functional rule regarding time window alignment and the business purpose of ensuring the right order reaches the right store staff at the right time.

origin.description: The system-generated assignment linking a specific order to a designated store partner and a specific time window for preparation and dispatch.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders fulfilled within the assigned time window.
Rate of SLA breaches due to time window misalignment.

policies_and_constraints: Time windows must fall within the store's defined opening hours.
Allocation must prioritize items with high demand or urgency.
assumptions: Store operational hours are accurately defined and available to the allocation engine.
Delivery SLAs are consistent and measurable.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Over-allocation of time slots may lead to missed preparation deadlines.
Dependency: Real-Time Inventory Snapshot must be available to validate stock before time slot assignment.

business_requirements.name: Dynamic Task Prioritization
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system must assign a priority level to each fulfillment task based on order urgency, item demand, and current store capacity to optimize resource utilization.
business_requirements.business_objective: To ensure high-value or urgent orders are processed ahead of lower-priority tasks within the store workflow.
business_requirements.business_value: Improves order throughput and ensures critical customer needs are met first, directly impacting the speed of fulfillment.
business_requirements.requirement_basis: The information requirement specifies that the system must provide a Task Priority Level and that allocation must prioritize items with high demand or urgency.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: This requirement is derived from the required information details regarding Task Priority Level and the functional rule regarding prioritization of high demand items.

origin.description: The system-generated assignment linking a specific order to a designated store partner and a specific time window for preparation and dispatch.

success_measures.measure: Average wait time for high-priority orders versus low-priority orders.
Percentage of high-demand items fulfilled within the first time window.

policies_and_constraints: Allocation must prioritize items with high demand or urgency.
Tasks cannot be assigned to stores outside their authorized service area.
assumptions: Urgency and demand levels can be quantified and compared across orders.
Store capacity is a dynamic variable that can be monitored in real-time.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Incorrect prioritization logic may lead to bottlenecks in store workflow.
Dependency: Real-Time Inventory Snapshot is required to validate stock availability for prioritization.

business_requirements.name: Resource Capacity Validation
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system must validate that the selected store partner has sufficient capacity and inventory to fulfill the order before assigning the task.
business_requirements.business_objective: To prevent order rejection or delays caused by stockouts or staff unavailability at the assigned store.
business_requirements.business_value: Ensures the reliability of the fulfillment promise and reduces operational waste from failed allocations.
business_requirements.requirement_basis: The information requirement states that allocation is triggered by the validation of an Order Request against Real-Time Inventory Snapshot and Service Area constraints.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: This requirement is logically deduced from the information flow trigger and the functional rule that tasks cannot be assigned to unauthorized stores, implying a need for validation.

origin.description: The system-generated assignment linking a specific order to a designated store partner and a specific time window for preparation and dispatch.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of allocated tasks successfully completed without inventory errors.
Rate of failed allocations due to capacity constraints.

policies_and_constraints: Tasks cannot be assigned to stores outside their authorized service area.
Routing must optimize for minimizing total delivery time.
assumptions: Real-Time Inventory Snapshot is accurate and up-to-date at the moment of allocation.
Store capacity limits are defined and enforceable.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Inventory data latency may lead to allocation to a store that cannot fulfill the order.
Dependency: Real-Time Inventory Snapshot and Service Area constraints must be available.

business_requirements.name: End-to-End Delivery Chain Integration
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system must pre-allocate a delivery partner to the fulfillment task to ensure seamless handover from store preparation to customer delivery.
business_requirements.business_objective: To minimize gaps in the fulfillment process and ensure the customer receives the order without interruption.
business_requirements.business_value: Improves the overall customer experience by providing a continuous service flow from order to delivery.
business_requirements.requirement_basis: The information requirement specifies that the required information details include an 'Assigned Agent ID (Pre-alloc)' for the delivery partner reserved for the subsequent leg.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: This requirement is derived from the required information detail regarding the pre-allocation of the delivery partner, ensuring the subsequent leg of the journey is secured.

origin.description: The system-generated assignment linking a specific order to a designated store partner and a specific time window for preparation and dispatch.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders with successful delivery partner handover.
Average time gap between order preparation completion and delivery pickup.

policies_and_constraints: Routing must optimize for minimizing total delivery time.
Tasks cannot be assigned to stores outside their authorized service area.
assumptions: Delivery partners are available to be pre-allocated based on the store's location and time window.
The delivery assignment system can integrate with the store allocation logic.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Delivery partner unavailability may lead to order delays or cancellations.
Dependency: Delivery Assignment System must be operational and integrated.
